name: Rotating Council Seats
mechanism: Distribute defined council duties through an agreed rotation among eligible participants
operating_requirement: Participating households, agreed eligibility and actual time for service
consequence: Share service obligations while turnover and exclusion rules have consequences

name: Customary Restitution Schedules
mechanism: Compare assessed harms with publicly understood forms of restitution and negotiated exceptions
operating_requirement: Recognized forum, evidence, affected parties and available compensation
consequence: Structure dispute repair without creating compensation resources or guaranteeing agreement

name: Intercommunity Oath Compacts
mechanism: Bind participating communities to publicly witnessed commitments and consequences for breach
operating_requirement: Legitimate representatives, communication and continuing reciprocal interest
consequence: Support cooperation while trust, enforcement and changed interests remain limits

name: Lineage Succession Rules
mechanism: Specify how recognized kin relationships order claims to an office
operating_requirement: Accepted kinship evidence, eligible claimants and a legitimate adjudication forum
consequence: Make hereditary succession claims more predictable without requiring their adoption

name: Council Elected Succession
mechanism: Select an officeholder through a defined council decision and transfer procedure
operating_requirement: Participating selectors, accepted eligibility and actual handover capacity
consequence: Offer an elective succession route with selector interests and contested outcomes

name: Succession Regency Arrangements
mechanism: Delegate limited temporary authority when an eligible officeholder cannot act
operating_requirement: Recognized delegation rules, capable delegates and accountable records
consequence: Maintain specified functions while limiting or contesting temporary authority

name: Confederal Delegate Mandates
mechanism: Give community delegates bounded authority and duties to report back
operating_requirement: Participating communities, accessible communication and maintained mandates
consequence: Coordinate common decisions while retaining limits of delegated consent

name: Subsidiarity Assignment Review
mechanism: Compare which level can carry out a function against evidence of capacity and spillovers
operating_requirement: Observed service responsibilities, participating authorities and review procedures
consequence: Reassign specific responsibilities without assuming central or local control is always superior

name: Plurality Vote Counting
mechanism: Choose the eligible option with the greatest valid vote count under declared tie rules
operating_requirement: Defined electorate, countable choices, observers and accepted counting procedures
consequence: Resolve a vote without claiming that the winner has majority support

name: Runoff Election Procedures
mechanism: Hold a subsequent restricted choice when a declared first-round condition is unmet
operating_requirement: Repeated participation, additional counting resources and accepted rules
consequence: Permit a later decisive contest at the cost of time and participation changes

name: Ranked Choice Transfer
mechanism: Transfer ranked ballots under a specified elimination or quota rule
operating_requirement: Clearly expressed rankings, trained counters and reproducible count records
consequence: Resolve a defined ranked contest while exhaustion and rule choice affect outcomes

name: Proportional Seat Allocation
mechanism: Convert valid group vote totals into a fixed number of seats using a declared allocation rule
operating_requirement: Defined districts, seat totals, reliable counts and transparent rounding rules
consequence: Represent qualifying shares within finite seats without guaranteeing perfect proportionality

name: Compensatory Mixed Representation
mechanism: Combine constituency selection with a specified compensatory allocation
operating_requirement: Reliable component counts, declared compensation rules and eligible candidates
consequence: Reduce defined disproportionality while retaining system-specific tradeoffs

name: Public Office Sortition
mechanism: Select eligible participants through an auditable random draw with stated exclusions
operating_requirement: Known eligible pool, credible draw mechanism and support for selected participants
consequence: Distribute access to office without claiming the draw produces expertise or consent

name: Representative Recall Procedures
mechanism: Trigger and resolve a defined challenge to a representative's continuing mandate
operating_requirement: Eligible petitioners, verifiable thresholds, a decision process and replacement rules
consequence: Allow removal under declared conditions while political conflict and disruption remain

name: Constituency Boundary Review
mechanism: Assess proposed representative districts against declared criteria and population evidence
operating_requirement: Accurate maps, population records, review capacity and public challenge
consequence: Make boundary effects contestable without erasing competing representation goals

name: Ballot Access Administration
mechanism: Apply declared candidate-entry conditions with notice and challenge procedures
operating_requirement: Accessible applications, accountable officials and available review
consequence: Administer candidate eligibility without treating restrictive rules as a research requirement

name: Accessible Voting Services
mechanism: Provide evaluated voting access while preserving independent choice and ballot secrecy
operating_requirement: Suitable materials, trained assistance, accessible locations and privacy arrangements
consequence: Enable more eligible participants to vote without transferring their choices to helpers

name: Legislative Amendment Tracking
mechanism: Track proposed text changes and their relation to the version being decided
operating_requirement: Retained drafts, competent clerks and clear decision records
consequence: Prevent disagreement over which text passed without guaranteeing wise policy

name: Bicameral Reconciliation
mechanism: Resolve differences between separately authorized deliberative bodies through declared procedures
operating_requirement: Existing bodies, comparable texts, delegates and accepted reconciliation rules
consequence: Reach or fail to reach a common measure with real negotiation and delay

name: Executive Veto Review
mechanism: Define a bounded return or refusal of a measure and the process for reconsideration
operating_requirement: Clearly assigned authority, public reasons and functioning review procedure
consequence: Add a review step with potential deadlock rather than a universal quality bonus

name: Ministerial Responsibility Hearings
mechanism: Require an officeholder to explain actions and evidence to an authorized reviewing body
operating_requirement: Accessible records, questioning capacity and consequences defined by adopted rules
consequence: Expose administrative conduct without assuming testimony ensures accountability

name: Participatory Budget Allocation
mechanism: Assign a defined portion of available public resources through an adopted participant decision process
operating_requirement: Real appropriated funds, eligible proposals, accessible participation and delivery staff
consequence: Allow participants to choose bounded expenditure while unfunded wishes remain unfunded

name: Citizen Deliberation Panels
mechanism: Support a selected group to examine evidence and produce a reasoned recommendation
operating_requirement: Accessible balanced evidence, skilled facilitation and participant time
consequence: Generate informed advice while mandate, representativeness and adoption remain distinct

name: Regulatory Impact Assessment
mechanism: Compare proposed rules against stated alternatives, affected groups and uncertain consequences
operating_requirement: Relevant evidence, analytical staff and transparent assumptions
consequence: Inform a rule choice without treating a forecast as an achieved outcome

name: Post Implementation Policy Review
mechanism: Compare observed policy effects with declared aims and revise the original assessment
operating_requirement: Consistent outcome evidence, review independence and authority to reconsider
consequence: Support policy learning without assuming all effects are measurable or reversible

name: Administrative Service Standards
mechanism: Publish measurable response and delivery commitments for defined public services
operating_requirement: Staffed service, suitable records and a feasible capacity estimate
consequence: Make service performance visible without creating capacity by declaration

name: Civil Birth Death Registration
mechanism: Record individual vital events continuously with evidence and correction procedures
operating_requirement: Reachable registrars, accepted evidence, records and protection against exclusion
consequence: Maintain event histories distinct from periodic population enumeration

name: Civil Status Record Correction
mechanism: Investigate and amend mistaken personal status records with retained provenance
operating_requirement: Accessible challenges, competent reviewers and reliable linked records
consequence: Repair administrative errors without silently changing another person's status

name: Residency Registration Services
mechanism: Maintain declared residence records with accessible updating and challenge
operating_requirement: Local registrars, actual resident information and feasible reporting channels
consequence: Support territorial service planning while mobility and missing records retain uncertainty

name: Portable Civic Credentials
mechanism: Allow a verified civic record to be recognized by another participating authority
operating_requirement: Accepted evidence, compatible recognition terms and actual delivery
consequence: Reduce repeated verification while retaining correction and trust dependencies

name: Identity Minimization Services
mechanism: Verify a specified eligibility fact while limiting unnecessary retained identity data
operating_requirement: Qualified verification method, accountable access and appropriate records
consequence: Support service eligibility without collecting every personal detail by default

name: Public Service Case Routing
mechanism: Route a request to the office actually responsible and preserve unresolved obligations
operating_requirement: Current responsibility map, staff and functioning handoff channels
consequence: Reduce lost requests while real workload and capacity still cause delays

name: Interagency Record Matching
mechanism: Link authorized records across offices while measuring false matches and omissions
operating_requirement: Compatible data, limited access, review staff and correction procedures
consequence: Support coordinated service without treating every similarity as identity

name: Public Service Interoperability
mechanism: Specify compatible exchanges of authorized service requests and results
operating_requirement: Participating offices, maintained interfaces and accountable access
consequence: Coordinate actual service handoffs without merging all records or authorities

name: Language Access Administration
mechanism: Provide qualified language access for public interactions and consequential records
operating_requirement: Competent interpreters or translators, appropriate materials and staff time
consequence: Make services more accessible while translation quality and capacity remain limits

name: Mobile Civic Registration
mechanism: Bring authorized registration capability to otherwise poorly served locations
operating_requirement: Qualified staff, transport, suitable records and verified local access
consequence: Extend actual registration reach without inventing residents or events

name: Land Tax Assessment
mechanism: Assess adopted land-tax obligations against recorded parcels and declared valuation rules
operating_requirement: Surveyed parcels, competent assessors, notice and appeal capacity
consequence: Collect against an explicit base while valuation error and distributional effects remain

name: Harvest Levy Assessment
mechanism: Assess an adopted levy against observed harvest under declared shares and exemptions
operating_requirement: Measured actual harvest, storage, assessors and transport
consequence: Transfer a bounded portion of existing produce with household and seed-reserve consequences

name: Poll Tax Registers
mechanism: Assess a declared per-person obligation against an accountable eligibility register
operating_requirement: Eligible population records, collection staff and challenge procedures
consequence: Make a specific tax base administrable while fixed burdens affect households unequally

name: Customs Valuation Procedures
mechanism: Assess declared border charges against classified goods and a stated valuation rule
operating_requirement: Actual trade goods, inspectors, records and review capacity
consequence: Collect adopted trade charges while delay, evasion and trade effects remain

name: Excise Duty Accounts
mechanism: Track adopted product-specific duties through defined production or release events
operating_requirement: Observed taxable output, accountable records and inspectors
consequence: Collect only from actual liable transactions while administrative costs persist

name: Income Tax Assessment
mechanism: Assess adopted personal or organizational income obligations under declared recognition rules
operating_requirement: Income evidence, competent staff, filing access and appeal processes
consequence: Apply a measured income-based charge without assuming perfect reporting

name: Progressive Tax Schedules
mechanism: Calculate liabilities using declared marginal bands and allowances
operating_requirement: Defined tax base, published schedules and competent calculation
consequence: Apply chosen burden distribution while revenue and behavior depend on actual incomes

name: Withholding Collection
mechanism: Collect an adopted portion of liability at the payment source and reconcile later obligations
operating_requirement: Participating payers, actual payments, records and refund or adjustment capacity
consequence: Change collection timing without collecting more than the applicable final obligation by design

name: Invoice Credit Taxation
mechanism: Calculate adopted value-added liability by reconciling taxable sales and eligible input credits
operating_requirement: Verifiable invoices, filing systems, competent reviewers and refund capacity
consequence: Tax defined value added while fraud, delays and compliance costs remain

name: Tax Expenditure Disclosure
mechanism: Estimate revenue implications of adopted exemptions and preferential rules against a declared reference
operating_requirement: Tax evidence, explicit baseline and analytical staff
consequence: Expose implicit fiscal choices while counterfactual estimates retain uncertainty

name: Revenue Sharing Formulas
mechanism: Allocate actual shared receipts through a published rule among participating authorities
operating_requirement: Measured collections, agreed shares and functioning transfers
consequence: Distribute existing revenue without double-counting it as new resources

name: Fiscal Equalization Transfers
mechanism: Allocate funded transfers against measured differences in fiscal capacity or service need
operating_requirement: Credible indicators, real funds and agreed calculation rules
consequence: Reduce selected service-resource disparities subject to available revenue and incentives

name: Intergovernmental Fiscal Consolidation
mechanism: Remove internal transfers when reporting combined public receipts and expenditure
operating_requirement: Comparable accounts, transfer identifiers and reconciliation staff
consequence: Prevent the same transferred resources from appearing as multiple new expenditures

name: Public Debt Service Schedules
mechanism: Record actual future principal and financing obligations against due dates and terms
operating_requirement: Accurate contracts, payment capacity and accountable treasury work
consequence: Expose financing commitments without treating borrowing as permanent income

name: Contingent Public Liability Registers
mechanism: Record conditional public commitments and plausible payment triggers
operating_requirement: Complete agreements, competent assessment and maintained exposure records
consequence: Make guarantees and contingent claims visible without assuming all will be paid

name: Public Payroll Verification
mechanism: Match authorized paid roles and actual service evidence before disbursement
operating_requirement: Staff records, independent checks and actual treasury funds
consequence: Reduce unsupported payments without creating workers or proving quality from attendance

name: Public Asset Disposal Procedures
mechanism: Authorize and record transfer or retirement of public assets against declared conditions
operating_requirement: Known assets, qualified valuation, custody and accountable proceeds
consequence: Dispose of actual assets while revealing losses and conflicts of interest
